title: Credit for Months a Medical Assistance Approval Left Out — Resident Funds Patient Pay
content:
For a standing Medicaid patient pay transfer from a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account, the patient pay credit that reaches the named charge includes **the credited not-eligible amount**. It follows the months the approval of the resident's case under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage left out, read from the case's standing as the approval fixes it, whatever the business office has posted so far:

| Case and ledger | Credited not-eligible amount |
|---|---|
| the case is eligible, every estimate billed while the case was pending is the same amount, and the application was made in a month before the eligibility start date's month | that estimate for each month from the application date's month up to the month before the eligibility start date's month, because an estimate is billed for each month the application is pending and the reconciliation reduces each of those months in full |
| the case is eligible and those estimates differ | the not-eligible-month reductions posted on the other charges |
| otherwise | nothing |

The months are counted in calendar months, the application date's month included and the eligibility start date's month excluded.

## Hypothetical illustration

Eligibility starts 1 February 2026.

| Application date | Estimates billed while pending | Reductions posted | Credited not-eligible amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| 14 November 2025 | $1260.00 every month | none | 3 months (November, December, January): $3780.00 |
| 14 November 2025 | $1260.00 every month | $2520.00 | $3780.00 |
| 14 November 2025 | $1260.00 and $1302.55 | $2520.00 | $2520.00 |
| 3 February 2026 | $1260.00 every month | none | nothing (same month as the eligibility start) |
